meaning: Recorded viable cell density mean; assay SOP, replicate counts, detection limit, rounding and QC unknown

proposed_masks.positive_only: finite VCD > 0; changes estimand to positive recorded VCD
proposed_masks.recorded_nonnegative: finite VCD >= 0; includes six unresolved numeric zeros

recommendation: Candidate retrospective research target; no accepted primary label policy
zero_policy: Preserve observed numeric zeros and coordinates; do not infer censoring bound, cell absence or zero uncertainty
